hints.title: Check for Marker Symbol Ahead
hints.text: Digits 10 through 26 are followed by a pound symbol, whereas digits 1 through 9 are single digits.

hints.title: Look Ahead Two Positions
hints.text: At index i, check if i + 2 < len(s) and s[i + 2] == hash symbol. If so, parse two digits; otherwise parse one digit.

hints.title: Convert to Lowercase Letter
hints.text: Map integer val to character via chr(ord(a) + val - 1).

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Backward replacement via regular expressions can be ambiguous if not carefully sorted by length.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Forward scan with two-character lookahead parses unambiguous tokens in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate inspects s[i + 2] == "#" to decide token length without backtracking.
complexity.notes: Backward scan from end of string is equally clean since hash marks appear at the end of tokens.
